text:
𝗧𝗪𝗢 𝗖𝗘𝗡𝗧𝗨𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦! 🇮🇳

Harmanpreet 126 (121) and Deepti 106* (86) add 153 for the 5th wicket as India Women post 328/6 vs Zimbabwe in the 2nd ODI 🔥

Zimbabwe chase 329 🏏

#WomensCricket #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗗𝗼 𝗦𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗸, 𝗲𝗸 𝗶𝗻𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴𝘀! 🇮🇳🔥

Vadodara mein India Women ne Zimbabwe ke khilaf 2nd ODI mein 328/6 bana diye! 🏏

👉 Harmanpreet Kaur – 126 (121 balls), ODI ka 8th century
👉 Deepti Sharma – 106* (86 balls)
👉 Dono ke beech 5th wicket ke liye 153 runs ki partnership
👉 Mandhana pehle over mein hi duck pe out

Kya Zimbabwe 329 chase kar payegi? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #WomensCricket #TeamIndia
